title: "AI Slop" Now BANNED in the Curl Project
summary: Linux podcast chat on curl banning AI-slop HackerOne reports after a hallucinated HTTP/3 'exploit'.

assertions.quote: We now ban every reporter instantly who submits reports we deem AI slop ... we are effectively being DDoSed

verdicts.note: curl's public data and statements from other maintainers (Python, Django, FFmpeg) document a sharp rise in fabricated AI reports; curl ended its bug bounty in 2026 partly because of it.

assertions.quote: Turns out that the code that this particular report was about didn't actually exist. It was made up

verdicts.note: Documented across curl's public HackerOne reports and other projects: fabricated stack traces, nonexistent functions, already-fixed CVEs.
